info.name: Harbinger Health WordPress REST API (wp/v2) Media API

description.content:
DERIVED, NOT PUBLISHED BY HARBINGER HEALTH. Harbinger Health publishes no OpenAPI definition and does not document or support this surface as a developer product. This document was derived mechanically by API Evangelist from the live WordPress route-discovery document fetched from https://harbinger-health.com/wp-json/ on 2026-08-04 (268 routes across 15 namespaces; the wp/v2 namespace is captured here). Every path, method, parameter name, type, enum, default and description is copied verbatim from that discovery document. Response bodies are intentionally left as generic objects because the discovery document does not publish response schemas; error responses are grounded in payloads probed live against this host. This is a content-management surface for the corporate website - it is NOT a clinical, laboratory, diagnostic, genomic or patient-data API, and no Harbinger HX or RESOLVE test data is reachable through it.

Contact Support:
 Name: Harbinger Health
 Email: info@harbinger-health.com
